name: Orbital Notification Center
author: afmpjr
description: Bell with an unread badge; click opens the notification history kept by this plugin (it outlives omarchy's 10-file history). Reads omarchy's on-disk notifications, never another plugin's live service.

barWidget.description: Bell with unread badge + notification history

schema.label: Mark what you have not read
schema.description: What the bell says about notifications that arrived since you last opened the center. A dot says there are some; a count says how many; none keeps the bell quiet.

schema.label: Keep notifications for
schema.description: Days. Past this a notification is deleted. Whichever of this and the count below is reached first wins.

schema.label: Keep at most
schema.description: Notifications. A ceiling on the archive regardless of age, so a chatty week cannot grow it without limit.

schema.label: Panel width
schema.description: In the shell's spacing units. Anything wider than the screen is trimmed to fit.
